name: Kitzingen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, light blue and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Kitzingen (a white bridge on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Kitzingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Kitzingen arms — white bridge on blue
